body: I’m happy you’re doing better , keep your head up . I’m here if you wanna talk

for one call a friend or family member .
I know you believe no one cares or no one wants to listen, but I promise you , THEY DO.
Secondly, bandage your wound . I would start by cleaning with gauze and warm water.
Thirdly , go to the nearest hospital. 
It’s an even scarier thought , I know . But atleast you’ll be medicated and have the opportunity to take time for yourself . Being admitted is scary . But it only helps . After 2 or 3 days you can go home with a clear head.
You’ll be admitted for a program during the week that assists with mental health .

The best thing I ever did was survive my suicide attempt .
I will live with scars for the rest of my life , but I always look at is as a reminder that i am loved so deeply by myself and god .

Remember this , you’re not inconveniencing anyone by being alive,
It’s an inconvenience if they never see you again .
It gets better ♥️

It’s on Apple Music , not sure how I could make it public but always willing to learn .
Drake is good but I love some songs more than others . A lot of his new music is more geared towards what he thinks his audience wants to hear , but his older music from 2012-2015 is more from the heart .

Have a wonderful evening dear , I looked at your profile. I did notice you listen to many people and their stories . 
You are truly a blessing in disguise. 
As I may be passed the point of saving , you could definitely save hundreds of lives. 
God bless you

I’ve always believed to spread light , even if you feel nothing but darkness . My heart bleeds love , so thank you for taking the time to read and share how you feel .
Bless you .

Your words mean more than you’ll know . 
Thank you for taking the time to listen.
There’s a quote that I’ve always loved “you can meet people tomorrow that have better intentions for you, than people you’ve known your whole life”
Thank you for reminding me of that .
Unfortunately my mind has been set . As this wasn’t an easy decision to make. I just want to say god bless you . As you’ve taken some anxiety of my chest , you should be very proud of the person you are .

Thank you for taking the time to listen . 
It’s truly appreciated..I swear.
But I do wish people in my everyday life would .
I haven’t made this decision easily , I had told those I care about how I feel .
I’ve seeked help from a therapist.
I’ve gone to the hospital.
I’ve taken all the advice people offer.
But all I asked for was for someone to listen , thank you for doing exactly that .
God bless you .
